purpose: Editor example only; not live fishing artwork replacement.
camera: Near broadside three-quarter, slightly above; stern left, bow right. Hull is the camera/light master.
sourcePolicy: Original generated project artwork; PNG masters retain alpha and are not trimmed. Previous front-facing stand remains unchanged.
supportArtDirection: Redesign the wide frontal U cradle as a compact vertical side-view adjustable boat keel jack. Keep clean transparent alpha, no floor, scene or external shadow.
occlusion: Example motor and support tops draw behind the hull. Final wrapping clamps and saddles need separate front/back images or masks; zIndex does not split a single image.
